status: Upgraded to current upstream release; residual build-tool advisories retained for review, not marked fixed.
scope: Yarn is a source-package build input and is absent from the binary runtime package. The source closure may include tree-shaken code.
controls: All package builds run without network access, with scripts and telemetry disabled.
Yarn and every archive are verified against independently reviewed checksums before execution.
The immutable lockfile and archive/member/license inventories are checked before and after builds.
Builds run as an unprivileged container user and use only the private, pinned cache.
Registry prefetching is a separate unprivileged preparation step; newly fetched inputs require renewed review and qualification.
release_followup: Monitor Yarn advisories/releases, reassess actual reachability before changing build inputs or permissions, and update/requalify the pinned build tool. Do not interpret this bounded build configuration as remediation for general interactive use.
